newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Fed approves Taiwanese banking applications.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Fed approves Taiwanese banking applications.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Reserve said on Monday it approved a proposal by First Commercial Bank of Taipei to become a bank holding company by buying all voting shares of FCB Taiwan California Bank in Alhambra, Calif.
First Bank is the fourth largest commercial bank in Taiwan with assets of $33 billion. It is 71 percent owned or controlled by the government of Taiwan.

The Fed also approved a proposal by Bank of Taiwan, the biggest bank in Taiwan with assets of $59.2 billion, to keep its 12.84 percent ownership of First Commercial and so acquire more than 5 percent of the voting shares of FCB Taiwan.
The Taiwanese government owns all of Bank of Taiwan.
In another proposal, the Fed granted its approval for the Land Bank of Taiwan, the third largest bank in Taiwan with assets of $41 billion, to establish a state-licensed branch in Los Angeles.

Land Bank also is wholly owned by the Taiwanese government. The Fed said Land Bank wanted to establish a Los Angeles branch to offer banking services to its existing clients in California and to facilitate international trade between the United States and Asia.
